thread:
Rina (Content): Quick update — interviewed HealthyBridge today for their case study. We captured a usable 90s soundbite about model cost savings and a longer section on how Redwood changed their release cadence. Need quote approval and a routing rule before we publish.

Dev (PMM): Awesome. Can you paste the one-line quote you want on the hero? I'll pair it with a 3-line deck for the landing.

Maya (Producer): Raw files are in Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/healthybridge-raw. I also marked two timestamps for a hero clip: 00:45-01:30. We need legal sign-off on quote + permission for a before/after chart.

Diego (AE): HealthyBridge prefers inbound demo leads from the case page to go to their CS Ops first, then to our SDR if no reply in 24h. We should add lead tags and a fallback owner.

hubspot-bot: To add routing, provide payload as comma-separated key=value pairs. Example: lead_source=case_study,owner=team-x.

Diego (AE): Use: lead_source=healthybridge_case,owner=healthybridge-cs-ops,fallback_owner=redwood-sdr,priority=high

Nina (Legal): Read the transcript. Two redlines: 1) the customer used an internal savings percentage — redact and replace with "substantial savings"; 2) they named a vendor we cannot call out — remove the vendor phrase. Send updated quote and I will confirm.

Rina (Content): Proposed hero quote (redacted): "Redwood delivered substantial savings on inference costs and let our teams ship features faster."

Dev (PMM): Suggest slight tweak for punch: "Redwood delivered substantial inference cost savings and helped our teams ship features faster." Keeps punchy rhythm.

Nina (Legal): Approved version from legal: "Redwood delivered substantial inference cost savings and helped our teams ship features faster." Approved with vendor redaction. Nina (Legal) :white_check_mark:

Maya (Producer): Great — I'll drop that on the landing draft and send clips to design. Diego, can you confirm the HubSpot payload so I can wire the CTA?

Diego (AE): Confirmed payload: lead_source=healthybridge_case,owner=healthybridge-cs-ops,fallback_owner=redwood-sdr,priority=high,campaign=hb_case_launch_2026

hubspot-bot: Routing rule queued to staging. Reminder: deploy to production 60 minutes before publish window.

Rina (Content): Thanks all. Plan: finalize landing copy, upload final quote asset, schedule publish + webinar invite (tentative date 2026-05-05). I'll ping when assets are ready for review. :calendar::rocket:
